更改谁可以查看或修改内容: Change who can view or edit content
以下内容供开发者排查问题，你无需填写或修改。: These details help developers troubleshoot. You do not need to fill them in or change them.
记住这次选择：同一扩展在这个项目中，由同一方发起相同操作时不再询问: Remember this choice for the same extension, project, operation and requester.
由 Amblelost 确认你的选择。填写的登录信息不会显示在扩展页面中。: Amblelost confirms your choice. Sign-in information you enter is not shown on the extension page.
这份草稿已被发送或删除。你的输入仍保留，请重新打开聊天后再继续。: This draft was sent or deleted. Your input is preserved. Reopen the conversation to continue.
这份草稿已被归档。你的输入仍保留，请先还原草稿。: This draft is archived. Your input is preserved. Restore the draft first.
这份草稿的内容已更新。你的输入仍保留，请重新打开草稿并核对后再发送。: This draft has changed. Your input is preserved. Reopen and review it before sending.
草稿信息尚未就绪。请重新启动 Amblelost 后再试。: Draft information is not ready. Restart Amblelost and try again.
发送前草稿发生了变化。你的输入仍保留，请重新打开聊天后再试。: The draft changed before sending. Your input is preserved. Reopen the conversation and try again.
以当前内容新建聊天: Start a new conversation with this content
这份草稿已归档。还原后可继续，也可以复制为新聊天。: This draft is archived. Restore it to continue, or copy it into a new conversation.
开发者尚未提供 README.md。: The developer has not provided a README.md.
启用并信任扩展后可配置: Enable and trust this extension to configure it
扩展提供的配置选项会显示在这里。: Configuration options provided by the extension appear here.
搜索名称、任务内容或快捷操作: Search names, task content, or actions
删除项目后，所属任务将一并归档，可在设置中还原。不会删除本机文件。: Tasks in this project will be archived and can be restored in Settings. Local files will not be deleted.
请在桌面版中打开交互内容: Open this interactive content in the desktop app
交互内容暂时无法使用。扩展可能已停用、更新，或需要重新授权。: This content is unavailable. The extension may have been disabled, updated, or need permission again.
管理扩展、配置和项目访问权限。: Manage extensions, configuration, and project access.
仅授权此扩展读取自己的配置，不授予项目或密钥权限。: Allow this extension to read its own configuration. Project and secret permissions are not granted.
扩展授权已变化。当前修改已保留，请重新加载配置后再保存。: Extension permissions changed. Your edits are preserved. Reload configuration before saving.
查看扩展需要的权限，并管理授权范围。: Review required permissions and manage access.
暂无可授权项目，请先创建项目。: Create a project before granting project access.
此扩展无需选择项目，仅授权其声明的扩展私有权限。: No project selection is needed. Only the declared extension-private permissions will be granted.
以上操作说明由扩展开发者提供。: Operation details are provided by the extension developer.
聊天会先保存为草稿，不会自动发送消息。: Chats are saved as drafts. No messages are sent automatically.
下次不再询问此操作: Don’t ask again for this operation
仅适用于同一扩展、项目和发起方的相同操作。可在扩展详情中恢复操作确认。: Applies only to the same operation, extension, project, and caller. You can reset confirmations in extension details.
离开后，本次未保存的修改将丢失。: Your unsaved changes will be lost if you leave.
更改自动保存并立即生效。: Changes are saved automatically and take effect immediately.
留空继承端点默认值。: Leave blank to inherit endpoint defaults.
端点默认容量。留空使用内核／服务端默认值；设置窗口后，未指定的压缩阈值按 80%: Endpoint defaults. Leave blank to use engine or server defaults. An unspecified compaction threshold uses 80% of the configured context window. Changes apply on the next turn.
使用 Ambleloft 独立引擎，无需安装 Codex。: Uses the Ambleloft engine. No Codex installation is needed.
配置与任务保存在 Ambleloft 自己的目录中，不复用官方 Codex 的登: Configuration and tasks are stored in Ambleloft’s own directory, separately from Codex sign-in and configuration.
默认使用项目固定版本: Uses the project-pinned version by default
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
可先编辑草稿，本轮结束后发送: You can draft now and send after this turn finishes
草稿尚未发送，请在本轮结束后发送。: Draft not sent. Send it after this turn finishes.
任务进行中，可随时停止: Task in progress · you can stop at any time
编辑技能名称、描述和指令。附属文件仅供查看。: Edit the skill name, description and instructions. Supporting files are read-only.
历史消息中的技能记录会保留。: Skill records in previous messages will be kept.
尚未保存的修改将丢失。: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
有未保存的修改 · Ctrl / ⌘ + S 保存: Unsaved changes · Ctrl / ⌘ + S to save
操作未成功，可以重新尝试。: The action failed. You can try again.
尚未确认处理结果，请在扩展中核对。为避免重复提交，暂时不能再次操作。: The outcome is not yet confirmed. Check in the extension. Resubmission is disabled to prevent duplicates.
操作未执行，可以重新尝试。: The action was not executed. You can try again.
暂时无法完成操作，请刷新消息或进入扩展查看。: Unable to complete the action. Refresh messages or check in the extension.
在扩展中点击连接账号，选择企业连接并登录。: Choose Connect account in an extension, select an enterprise connection, and sign in.
管理扩展使用的登录账号和认证配置。本地功能无需登录。: Manage accounts and authentication configurations used by extensions. Local features require no sign-in.
暂无已登录账号。需要登录时，请在扩展中点击“连接账号”。: No signed-in accounts. To sign in, choose “Connect account” in an extension.
保存配置不会自动登录。请在需要登录的扩展中选择此配置并完成登录。: Saving does not sign you in. Select this configuration in an extension and complete sign-in.
需要接入自己的身份认证服务时再添加。请向服务提供方获取服务地址和客户端 ID。: Add one when you need your own identity provider. Get the issuer URL and client ID from your provider.
删除此认证配置后，将无法使用它发起新的登录。: Deleting this configuration prevents new sign-ins using it.
认证配置已保存，可在扩展登录时使用。: Authentication configuration saved and ready for extension sign-in.
支持 OpenID Connect（OIDC）身份认证服务。请填写服务提供方给出: Supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity providers. Enter the configuration supplied by your provider.
用于在登录时识别此配置，可自行命名。: Choose a name to identify this configuration when signing in.
填写以 https:// 开头的认证服务地址，不是登录页面的网址。: Enter the HTTPS issuer URL, not the sign-in page URL.
由认证服务提供方分配的应用标识，不是账号或密码。: The application identifier assigned by your provider, not your username or password.
仅在服务提供方要求限制租户时填写，否则留空。: Only enter a value if your provider requires a tenant restriction; otherwise leave blank.
配置扩展登录时使用的认证服务。仅在扩展要求时添加。: Configure an identity provider for extension sign-in. Add one only when an extension requires it.
请查看请求详情，确认操作内容后再决定。: Review the request details before deciding.
提交未成功，请重试。: Could not submit your decision. Please retry.
此授权仅用于当前请求，不会开启完全访问。: This approval applies only to this request and does not enable full access.
提交结果待核实，请勿重复提交: Submission status unknown. Check before submitting again.
选择侧栏组织方式，不改变你的项目、任务和扩展。: Choose how the sidebar is organized. Your projects, tasks and extensions stay the same.
按项目、任务、扩展分别浏览。: Browse projects, tasks and extensions separately.
今天，想完成什么？: What would you like to work on today?
连接模型服务即可执行任务，当前可保存草稿。: Connect a model service to run tasks. You can save a draft for now.
Enter 保存草稿 · Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to save draft · Shift+Enter for a new line
新建项目，将工作目录和相关任务整理在一起。: Create a project to organize a working folder and its tasks.
点击新建任务开始。项目内的任务请在项目中查看。: Create a task to get started. Find project tasks under Projects.
前往管理扩展，安装或启用你需要的扩展。: Open Manage extensions to install or enable extensions.
